Simply outstanding!
Jun 2025 • Couples
Take me today I was a bit trepidation about going to this restaurant as the reviews were mixed. But having had the privilege of dining at a number of fine establishments around the world this restaurant really exceeded my expectations and I’m looking forward to going back again. I would write at the same level as Les Amis in Singapore. The service was just the way to blend of genuinely engaging but sincere and not intrusive. Enjoyed all of the dishes and I can’t criticise any of it. Bread basket was fantastic. It reminded meif Joel Robuchon in the good old days. View was spectacular and the Chef was genuinely interested in talking to you. I expect it will be awarded a star very soon

Heartfelt service and exquisite food!
Nov 2022 • Couples
The overall experience was wonderful! It makes the price seem cheap compared to the excellent quality of service and food here!

The staffs are all really nice and they make your dininng time feel heartwarm. In particular, Alex was hearty in showing the way, Kayla is an excellent bartender who caters for her guests in a very active, friendly way. I am also especially impressed at Francis for his food knowledge, his friendliness and engagement when serving his customers.

As for the food, gotta say Chef Pierrick has both a great sense of arts and excellent cooking level! Our food was both gorgeous to look at and exquisite to dine! Totally deserving of the Michelin stars he got!

Made our anniversary an unforgettable memory!

Amazing restaurant - complete culinary experience and stunning view!
Oct 2020
I visited this swish establishment with my fiancee for dinner on Tuesday 6th October 2020 (table for 2).... quite simply, we had an unforgettable experience. The service was second-to-none. The food was absolutely delicious. The view was amazing..... Our expectations were exceeded several times, especially regarding the complimentary foods they gave us in addition to our main order...... and yes, we were served plenty of truffle! It is not certainly not cheap, but it is certainly worth the price (so I say it is excellent value, as far as luxury dining goes)..... a very high-quality establishment obviously at the top of its game..... very highly recommended. Flawless!
